data.notes: September 2026 already has a strong confirmed mix of Brazilian festivals, arena pop, heritage MPB/sertanejo, and international rock/indie shows in São Paulo.

events.title: Coala Festival 2026
events.summary: Coala Festival’s 12th edition is confirmed for 12–13 September 2026 at Memorial da América Latina, celebrating Brazilian music across generations.

events.title: aespa: 2026-27 aespa LIVE TOUR - SYNK : COMPLæXITY
events.summary: K-pop group aespa is confirmed for a São Paulo arena date on 4 September 2026 as part of the SYNK : COMPLæXITY world tour.

events.title: 5 Seconds Of Summer - Everyone's A Star World Tour
events.summary: Australian pop band 5 Seconds of Summer is confirmed at Suhai Music Hall on 18 September 2026, with the show scheduled for 21:00.

events.title: The Grid: OUTWORLD Klangkuenstler
events.summary: Klangkuenstler brings his OUTWORLD hard-techno concept to São Paulo for a long-set, no-phone-policy event presented by The Grid at ARCA, billed as a larger-scale follow-up to the 2025 edition.

events.title: SUN.SP 2026
events.summary: The 11th edition of SUN.SP is a 12-hour tech-house and house event at Arena Canindé, with Sidney Charles, wAFF, Archie Hamilton, Latmun b2b Yaya, Cuartero b2b Hector Couto, Nacho Scoppa b2b Bruno Furlan, Tomi & Kesh and resident Grecco confirmed.

events.title: Helloween - 40 Years Anniversary Show
events.summary: German metal band Helloween is confirmed for a 40th-anniversary concert at Suhai Music Hall on 19 September 2026, with the show scheduled for 21:00.

events.title: Cabaré – O Último Encontro: Leonardo e Bruno & Marrone
events.summary: Leonardo and Bruno & Marrone bring the farewell edition of the Cabaré project to Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu on 12 September 2026.

events.title: Zé Ramalho - Temporada de Sucessos
events.summary: Zé Ramalho is confirmed for a 12 September 2026 concert at Espaço Unimed, with doors at 20:00 and show time at 22:00.

events.title: Ben Howard 2026 Tour
events.summary: English singer-songwriter Ben Howard is confirmed for Audio in São Paulo on 26 September 2026, with the show scheduled for 21:00.

events.title: Mateus Asato - Asatour
events.summary: Brazilian guitarist Mateus Asato brings Asatour to Teatro Bradesco on 10 September 2026, with Uhuu listed as the official ticket channel.

events.title: Oswaldo Montenegro - A Dança dos Signos
events.summary: Oswaldo Montenegro’s A Dança dos Signos is confirmed for Espaço Unimed on 19 September 2026, with show time listed as 21:30.

events.title: São Paulo Oktoberfest 2026
events.summary: São Paulo Oktoberfest 2026 is confirmed from 18 September to 4 October, with music, culture, food and German-inspired celebration across 13 event days.
